criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold value register on all nine. The hero is the kit SUV with box pods and reads as a CAD block on 1, 2, 4, 6 and 7. Slide 3 is no showstopper: an opaque black plane, no ledges or bank, a brown slab floating at roof height. Slide 6's car hovers with its wheels cut at the comal line. Slide 8's window car reads as a toy on a bookshelf. Slide 2's pole runs behind the dek and the rider presses into the bumper. Slide 9 the strongest; slide 7 a clean data frame.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one unchanged hero, one grade; comal for the water line only; dark values with no strobe; two devices work. Slide 8 slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and re-derives; slide 7 lights 177 and slide 5 draws 3791 in code; slide 8's fields match the record byte for byte; c26 verbatim. Held at 7.5: slide 4's labels are TPR's paraphrase where the Part 573 filing was not fetched; slide 4's hook states the modal as an event; the day-first May 1st reading rests on 26E035 (c25, context only) missing from the first comment; 'recall lookup' names a surface not fetched; slide 8's interim sentence drops 'Waymo told NHTSA'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where and the stake land; the action general with 26E026 unprinted for a feed reader; no public decider beyond Waymo and NHTSA.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover tension, frame 2 steps back, turn at 3, 4 to 6 build, 7 restates and leaves May 1st unexplained, the close lands.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Restrained and specific; flat lines on 2 and 8; no house rule breaks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New palette; no. 50's San Antonio night flood four days earlier; one object per day, instanced count and person-beside-hero close repeat recent decks.

one_sentence_fix: Replace the boxy kit SUV robotaxi with a properly modelled body and build slide 3's actual creek with ledges, a far bank, a streetlight and ripple-broken water at mid-door.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No creek; an opaque black plane; a brown slab floating at roof height.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the slab; limestone ledges on both banks with the far bank lamp; the standing_water sheet at mid-door.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat box nose-on; wheels cut by the comal line so the car hovers.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swing 15 to 20 degrees off axis; the water edge about 1 m in front of the tyres with contact on dry asphalt.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The window doesn't read as a window; toy car on a bookshelf.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A large window with blinds behind the monitor; the car 10 m outside under its own lamp; crop the books.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The pole crosses the dek; the rider pressed into the bumper.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Move the lamp about 3 m east; the rider 1.2 m off the car toward the camera.
A raked windscreen and arch cutouts in CH.carField; the camera at about 12 m.
